findings.detail: Both documentary.yaml (lines 21-22) and with_translation.yaml (lines 25-26) now contain electronic: {day: none}. This replaces the ElectronicSettings.day default of 'now' (exporter/settings.py:163), so the device date can no longer suppress the fixed printed Ten Days Kaddish. Per settings.py:160-162, 'none' means every day-dependent passage is shown with its rubric. The other ElectronicSettings fields (columns, psalm_titles) stay at their defaults. The YAML keys fit the model's extra='forbid' schema.

build.py:681-682 sets settings['electronic'] = {'day': 'none'} only when project != EXPANDED. Both documentary variants (documentary and with_translation) use PROJECTS['he'], so they get the setting. EXPANDED/undated does not, so it keeps the existing 'now' default. The generator's output key order (parallel before electronic, electronic last) matches both checked-in YAML files, so a rebuild should not change them.

test_regeneration_keeps_documentary_previews_independent_of_device_day (test_marmorstein_rosh_hashanah_1.py:287-292) regenerates the settings and asserts electronic.day == 'none' for both documentary variants.

No test checks that the expanded undated.yaml leaves out the electronic key. Its existing default is currently guaranteed only by the generator condition at build.py:681. An optional assertNotIn('electronic', settings) in test_sparse_translation_and_shared_expanded_order (around line 103-104) would lock this in. This is not required to resolve the finding.
The diff in the files read adds one settings key in data and generator, plus one test. It adds no new features and changes no exporter/runtime code: ElectronicSettings already supported day='none'.
